title: Integration of machine learning to identify diagnostic genes in leukocytes for acute myocardial infarction patients.
summary: Integrated ML selected leukocyte diagnostic genes from four AMI datasets; the abstract reports a separate 20 AMI/20 stable-coronary-disease clinical validation, supporting a specific diagnostic result.
